title: [SEP-14] The MIMI provider endpoint cannot do what §9.1 says without group secrets
description: Review finding SEP-14: The MIMI provider endpoint cannot do what §9.1 says without group secrets (lens SEP). Location: spec/09-interop.md:67 (not 216-218). Fix: As proposed. Posting to relays needs `accessSig` and sealing, both of which are exporter-derived (05:202, 218), so "holds no MLS group secrets" is false. State that the endpoint holds the access and sealing exporter outputs, or is a group member, as a CO component (09:8, 65 already make it CO). Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/09-interop.md §9.1 (lines ~69-74): endpoint holds admission key as CO component and sealing exporter output either as passive member or via CO member; must not pass to IO
